what: Legend: Raja Indra Narayan built the Indreswari temple at Matbati on the direction of Brahmananda Giri, spiritual guide of the Naldanga family; the Giri ascetic later vanished into the Kalikatala pool. Giri name suggests Daśanāmī but order not stated.
quote: built a beautiful temple at Matbati under the directions of Brahmananda Giri, the spiritual guide of the family

what: Naldanga Raj set aside part of its zamindari (Iswarbrithi) for worship at Matbati; link to the Giri guide only by the legend.
quote: The Naldanga Baj family has set apart a portion of their zamindari called Iswarbrithi to meet the expenses of the daily worship of the idols at Matbati

what: Raghunath temple endowed 1813 by Krishna Das Brajabasi with five villages' rents; feeds travellers and religious mendicants; order of mendicants not stated.
quote: Near Murali, two miles from the station, is a temple containing an idol of Raghunath with on endowment, which is spent in the maintenance of the temple and the worship of the idol, and in feeding travellers and religious mendicants.
